summary: Repair public Ubuntu CI reproducibility by isolating profile-test secrets in memory while retaining the Windows DPAPI contract test, and regenerate the public manifest from a fresh LF checkout.
decision_refs: GitHub Actions run 37673736407 for commit 68e9eac failed: two profile tests required Windows DPAPI on Ubuntu, and the committed manifest was calculated against Windows checkout line endings rather than the commit bytes.

The profile-test repair must use an in-memory secret backend only for the affected tests, retain their existing assertions, and retain the Windows real-DPAPI coverage. Application and production credential behavior are out of scope.

The manifest was regenerated from a fresh LF checkout and checked against exact Git archive bytes: 797 entries, no missing, extra or mismatched files. The same verifier rejects the original commit's 505 newline mismatches. Historical Windows evidence is not a remote CI pass.

The new frozen Windows ci-repair-gate-r1 passes all seven release commands, 2762 unique Python tests with zero failures/errors/skips/duplicate nodes, 24 language tests, 11 deployment-entry tests and 160 requirements/37 schemas. All 797 source entries remain unchanged; JUnit duration is 1646.072 seconds. Only five metadata files are updated after that gate; exact identities and pre-push limits are in docs/PUBLIC_SYNC_VALIDATION.md.
approval_evidence: 2026-10-07 user approved modifying and synchronizing the CI failure repair, limited to test-secret isolation, LF-derived manifest regeneration, and governance records.
known_limitations: The targeted 23 tests, including actual Windows DPAPI, overlap the new full local gate and are not added to its count. This record is written before push; remote acceptance must be read from the resulting commit's Actions run. No default-branch merge, deployment, customer-data action or model-provider call is claimed.
The prior Windows local 2,762-test result remains historical evidence and does not establish Ubuntu CI compatibility or validate the commit archive manifest.
The repair does not alter application or production credential handling. The real Windows DPAPI test remains platform-specific coverage.
